Its five packages provide an SDK, command-line interface, Hermes integration, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore adapter.
highlights: Stores memory locally in a SQLite file
Includes FTS5 search and a five-tier schema
Offers SDK, CLI, Hermes, MCP, and LangGraph packages

obra/superpowers.summary: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills and initial instructions that prompt the agent to use them. It guides an agent from spec gathering and design sign-off through an implementation plan and a subagent-driven development process, with skills that trigger automatically. Installation instructions are provided for a range of coding agent harnesses.
highlights: Composable skills with instructions that make agents use them
Workflow covers spec, design sign-off, plan, subagent execution
Install separately per harness; many harnesses documented

Capslockb/hermes-live-discord-agent-plug.summary: Hermes Live is a self-hosted Hermes Agent plugin that connects Discord voice channels to the Google Gemini Multimodal Live API. It enables real-time voice conversation and supports optional tool integrations and notifications.
highlights: Full-duplex Discord voice input and output
Supports Gemini Multimodal Live sessions
Provides JSONL voice-event records

indranilbanerjee/contentforge.summary: ContentForge is an open-source content production plugin that runs a 10-phase pipeline to produce publication-ready .docx files with fact-checking, internal linking, and C2PA provenance. It includes a humanizer, a run auditor that re-derives quality gates, and a lifecycle loop for measuring and auditing published content. It installs on Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, and other agent platforms.
highlights: 10-phase pipeline with script-checked quality gates
Outputs .docx with C2PA provenance sidecar
Requires typed yes before publishing or translating

piprail/piprail.summary: PipRail is an implementation of the x402 "402 Payment Required" standard designed for agent-to-merchant payments. It provides an SDK and MCP server to enable direct wallet-to-wallet transactions across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, NEAR, Sui, Aptos, Algorand, Stellar, and the XRP Ledger.
highlights: Provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments
Includes an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets
Operates without a backend, database, or API keys

ccf/agentcairn.summary: agentcairn provides a cross-project memory system for coding agents that stores context as Markdown files in a local vault. It uses a disposable DuckDB index for retrieval and supports integration with tools like Claude Code and Codex via MCP plugins.
highlights: Stores durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata.
Uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval.
Integrates with coding agents via MCP servers and host-specific plugins.

sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools.summary: sourcevault-code-tools is a Hermes Agent plugin for searching code, reading exact files, and answering repository questions with file-and-line citations. It connects to a separate SourceVault backend and is described as running on the user’s machine over localhost without source code leaving it.
highlights: Provides slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A.
Supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop.
Includes repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.

Shine8592/china-briefing.summary: China Briefing is a multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator designed for Hermes Agent. It generates structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales using Tavily API for web searches.
highlights: Supports multiple geographic scales from global to street level
Generates structured reports with core conclusions and action suggestions
Integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion

IVRZ-da/agentiker-code-intel.summary: agentiker-code-intel is a Hermes plugin providing AST-aware code intelligence using tree-sitter, ast-grep, and LSP. It offers 70 tools for tasks such as symbol extraction, structural search, and impact analysis across supported languages.
highlights: Supports C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust, TSX, and TypeScript
Uses a SQLite-persistent import graph for knowledge queries
Provides LSP-powered definition, references, and diagnostics

corsur/swarm-tips.summary: Swarm Tips is an AI agent platform featuring Solana and EVM smart contracts for decentralized coordination and task marketplaces. It includes the Coordination Game for anonymous social deduction and Shillbot for AI-driven content creation tasks, supported by a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agent interaction.
highlights: Supports Solana (Anchor) and EVM (Foundry) smart contract deployments.
Provides MCP server endpoints for AI agent discovery and messaging.
Implements on-chain escrow for task payments and game stakes.

TauricResearch/TradingAgents.summary: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework that models the dynamics of real-world trading firms. It assigns tasks to specialized roles, including analyst, trader, and risk-management roles, and supports dynamic discussions about trading strategies. The README says it is designed for research purposes and is not financial, investment, or trading advice.
highlights: Uses specialized roles for trading tasks
Agents engage in dynamic strategy discussions
Designed for research purposes

IVRZ-da/agentiker-plan-follow.summary: plan_follow is a Hermes plugin for structured plan creation and task enforcement. It provides tools for managing task dependencies, parallel execution groups, review gates, and git integration.
highlights: Supports 12 templates for plan creation
Includes 6 review profiles for task validation
Provides git integration for branches, commits, and PRs

IVRZ-da/agentiker-scout.summary: agentiker-scout is a Hermes plugin providing tools for code and architecture analysis, vulnerability scanning, and autonomous web research. It utilizes a shared pattern pipeline to allow findings from analysis scans to inform automated bug-hunt scans.
highlights: Includes 56 tools across three functional domains
Supports automated pattern-based vulnerability scanning
Provides autonomous web research with lifecycle management

visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes.summary: MongrelDB-Hermes is a hybrid long-term memory plugin for the Hermes Agent that uses multiple index types for retrieval. It supports dense ANN, sparse retrieval, exact text, and metadata filtering with built-in MinHash deduplication.
highlights: Supports AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default
Offers native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution modes
Includes HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval

Fruxano/fruvisi.summary: FruVisi is a dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that provides an interactive 2D organizational chart for managing agent structures. It enables functional presets for team lineups, per-agent OpenRouter fallbacks, and kanban task integration via the native Hermes API.
highlights: Interactive 2D org chart using React Flow
One-click functional presets for team lineups
Per-agent OpenRouter fallback configuration

stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge.summary: Hermes Local Knowledge is a reusable Hermes Agent plugin that routes local questions to likely artifacts, such as skills, documents, scripts, runbooks, cron jobs, MCP servers, and generated tool-routing notes. It provides tools to search, fetch, and traverse artifacts, and its search results are routing hints; the agent should read the selected source before acting.
highlights: Registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports.
Indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources.
Registers pre_llm_call, on_session_end, and on_session_finalize hooks.

chenwei791129/hermes-usage-hook.summary: Hermes Usage Hook is a plugin for the Hermes Agent that appends LLM provider rate-limit usage data to the end of every reply. It detects the provider based on the model name and fetches usage statistics for Codex and MiniMax, including 5-hour and weekly windows.
highlights: Appends usage percentages and reset times to agent replies.
Supports Codex and MiniMax providers via model name detection.
Requires pyyaml as the only runtime dependency.

ClaudioDrews/memory-os.summary: Memory OS is a local memory infrastructure for Hermes Agent that utilizes a seven-layer system to store and retrieve information across sessions. It integrates SQLite, Qdrant, and Redis to provide structured fact storage, semantic search, and an auto-curated wiki pipeline while remaining compatible with various LLM providers.
highlights: Seven-layer memory system including vector search and structured facts
Local infrastructure using Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite
Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agent prioritizes injected context

uzairansaruzi/hermex.summary: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted hermes-webui server, which the user must run and expose themselves. It supports streaming chat with model, workspace, and profile options, plus sessions, tasks, skills, a workspace browser, and read-only memory and insights panels. The app is free, has no analytics or tracking, and talks only to the user's server.
highlights: Native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+
Client only; you run the server
Free, no analytics or tracking

sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control.summary: Hermy HQ is a self-hostable dashboard template designed to manage a local Hermes AI agent through a shared Postgres database acting as a message bus. Users can dispatch tasks, review agent plans, and manage memory via a web interface while the agent remains on a local machine.
highlights: Uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents and web dashboards
Features an approval inbox for requests with side effects
Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS v4

bookunt3d/hermes-agent-fa.summary: This repository contains a complete Persian translation of the official Hermes Agent documentation. The project uses GitHub Pages and includes full support for right-to-left (RTL) text direction.
highlights: Complete Persian translation of Hermes Agent documentation
GitHub Pages site with RTL support

amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile.summary: This project enables the Hermes AI agent framework to run on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It allows users to interact with multiple AI personas through a CLI or via Telegram using an API key.
highlights: Supports Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH)
Integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging
Supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux

InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel.summary: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local-first AI agent framework that uses Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) orchestration to route tasks to specialized models. It integrates with Hermes and Ollama to run agentic workflows on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies.
highlights: Implements Mixture-of-Agents via parallel model querying and synthesis
Uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling
Optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware

0xarkstar/awesome-hermes-agent.summary: This project is a curated list of resources, tools, and projects for Hermes Agent, a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research. It includes links to official documentation, deployment options, skills, and various community integrations.
highlights: Curated list of Hermes Agent resources
Includes deployment and skill integration links
Links to official Nous Research documentation

zcweah1981/awesome-hermes-agent-zh.summary: This project provides a Chinese-language documentation hub and implementation guide for Hermes Agent. It offers structured paths for local deployment, domestic model integration in China, and migration from OpenClaw.
highlights: Guides for integrating DeepSeek, Alibaba, Tencent, and other domestic models.
Documentation for multi-agent orchestration and MCP tool integration.
Troubleshooting references for installation, CLI, and gateway issues.

Javis603/token-monitor.summary: Token Monitor is a desktop widget for viewing live token usage and AI tool limits across supported coding tools. It also provides historical usage trends and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project, with multi-device sync.
highlights: Supports token usage across 46+ AI coding tools.
Shows historical trends and usage breakdowns.
Syncs across multiple devices.

freestylefly/wesight.summary: WeSight is an open-source desktop control console for local AI agents, providing a visual workspace to manage coding agents, tool execution, and file changes. It supports the installation and configuration of multiple agent engines and model providers through a unified graphical interface.
highlights: Supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent engines.
Includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency.
Provides a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.

spacering-net/codeg.summary: Codeg brings multiple AI coding agents into one workspace, where they appear in a shared structured conversation interface. It can import, search, and resume agent histories, hand sessions to another agent, and support cross-agent delegation and queued to-dos in separate worktrees. The README lists desktop, self-hosted server, Docker, mobile, and messaging-app access.
highlights: Includes 19 agents and supports ACP agents.
Import, search, resume, and hand off agent sessions.
Delegate across agents or queue to-dos in worktrees.

mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills.summary: PM Skills is an open-source library of markdown files that teach AI assistants to handle professional tasks, including writing PRDs, synthesizing user interviews, and decoding leases. The README says the skills can be installed for tools including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, or copied from the exports for ChatGPT and Gemini.
highlights: Each skill includes a framework, output template, and quality checks.
The README describes 1,295 skills.
The project is MIT-licensed.

Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop.summary: Hermes Agent CN Desktop is a desktop client for the Hermes Agent Chinese community, built with Tauri v2, Rust, React, and TypeScript. It provides a native interface for Windows and macOS to manage the Hermes-CN-Core agent runtime, local processes, and model service configurations.
highlights: Supports Windows and macOS with native window and process management.
Features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check and update capabilities.
Includes UI for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.

agent37-platform/minions.summary: Minions is a centralized management interface for Hermes Agent that replaces fragmented terminal sessions with a unified dashboard. It utilizes a Kanban-style board to track persistent agent sessions, allowing users to monitor reasoning, tool calls, and task progress in real time. The system enforces a human-in-the-loop workflow where agents propose completions that require manual verification before being marked as done. Users can also manage scheduled recurring jobs and browse agent-created files through a local-first SQLite architecture.
highlights: Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and review queues
Live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution
Human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions

hermes-labs-ai/lintlang.summary: LintLang is a local, deterministic static linter for AI agent instructions and tool interfaces. It scans supported content in project files for issues such as ambiguous tools, schema gaps, missing bounds, and mixed output formats, and reports findings with suggested fixes and line references where supported.
highlights: Scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent-facing files.
Supports JSON, SARIF, and GitLab Code Quality reports.
Findings are advisory by default; scans can gate on severity.

runta-dev/clawshell.summary: ClawShell is a security-privileged process that acts as a safety harness for the Hermes Agent ecosystem by protecting sensitive credentials and PII. It functions as a proxy between the agent and upstream LLM providers, swapping virtual keys for real ones stored in a restricted directory to ensure the agent never has direct access to credentials. The system performs Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scanning to redact or block sensitive information in request and response bodies. Additionally, it provides secure email isolation through IMAP sender filtering and supports OAuth-based authentication for providers like OpenAI.
highlights: Maps virtual keys to real credentials stored in protected Unix directories
Scans and redacts PII in request and response bodies via regex
Enforces sender-based email filtering for secure mailbox access

EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio.summary: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available as a desktop app and a self-hosted web console. It supports Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and coding-agent integrations, with features including session management, platform channels, workflows, file tools, and usage views.
highlights: Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux; also available through npm and Docker.
Supports shared chats, group chat, visual workflows, and persistent sessions.
Includes tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management.

generalbusiness-ai/keep.summary: Keep is a reflective memory system for AI agents that facilitates long-term learning and contextual awareness. It processes diverse inputs—including URLs, codebases, and multimedia—by summarizing, embedding, and organizing them into a searchable graph. The system uses 'edge tags' to create navigable relationships between notes, such as linking speakers to transcripts or commits to files. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other MCP-compatible tools to help agents track intentions and reflect on past actions.
highlights: Semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal
Automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support
Edge tags create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes

mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne.summary: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for AI agents that installs via pip and requires no external services. It works with MCP clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Windsurf, as well as OpenWebUI, OpenClaw, and Python agents through a direct SDK. The README reports BEAM benchmark results measured on v3.0.0 and notes that LongMemEval results are pending.
highlights: SQLite-backed memory layer; one pure-Python dependency
Integrates via MCP, native providers, or Python SDK
BEAM results reported for v3.0.0; LongMemEval pending

chillerno1/hermes-yt-plugin.summary: This plugin provides a compact YouTube player for the Hermes Desktop client that functions in floating or docked modes. It uses an isolated Electron webview to play watch pages, playlists, Shorts, Live, and embed links without requiring an API key.
highlights: Supports floating or docked pane modes
Saves favourites and up to 50 recent videos
Uses an isolated webview session

topoteretes/cognee.summary: Cognee turns documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph that agents can search and reuse across sessions. Its local quickstart builds and queries memory using local extraction and embedding models without an LLM; generated answers require additional LLM configuration.
highlights: Structures text as entities, relationships, and searchable chunks.
Supports custom data models and ontologies.
Offers plugins and MCP for connecting agents.

topoteretes/cognee-integrations.summary: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages that give agent frameworks a persistent memory layer backed by cognee, described as a permanent knowledge graph plus a fast session cache. It lists installable packages for frameworks including Strands, CrewAI, LangGraph, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, n8n, and Dify, plus chat bot and editor integrations that talk to a running cognee server over its HTTP API. A Claude Code plugin provides persistent memory across sessions by auto-capturing prompts, tool traces, and responses and auto-recalling context.
highlights: Monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages
Two tiers: permanent knowledge graph and session cache
Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context

Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil.summary: Hermes Brasil is a Portuguese-language community repository for Hermes Agent, with skills, guides, and resources for Brazilian users. It includes instructions for installing skills, recommended guides, and contribution steps; its README says integrations and community directories are planned, not part of the current repository.
highlights: Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format
Guides cover installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring
Contributions are submitted through pull requests

freehul/progressive-skill.summary: Progressive Skill reduces the size of an agent’s skills index by demoting selected categories to compact count lines and applying a configurable character budget. It uses toolset mappings and recency-weighted skill usage to decide what remains fully visible; the README says the repository is no longer actively updated and is retained as a design reference.
highlights: Includes a Hermes plugin and an agent-agnostic Python decision core.
Demoted skills remain discoverable through skills_list.
Usage scores decay based on recency.

handnewb/hermes-voice.summary: Hermes-voice is a voice-enabled personal assistant designed for Hermes Agent. It operates entirely locally using speech recognition, voice activity detection, wake word detection, and speech synthesis.
highlights: Supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
Features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.
Runs offline with no API keys or accounts required.

MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG.summary: Hermes OTG is a portable, zero-install version of the Hermes Agent designed for Windows 10 and 11. It operates from any drive or folder using relative paths to avoid host system pollution and can run side-by-side with an installed Hermes instance using a separate port and data directory.
highlights: Runs from USB or any drive without host installation or registry writes.
Includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments.
Bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools for offline use.

jiawood2006/hermes-skills.summary: Hermes Skills is a collection of nine open-source tools designed for Chinese-language agent tasks such as video transcription, document OCR, and text refinement. The project provides scripts for processing Douyin links, generating e-commerce product scenes, and managing long-form writing memory.
highlights: Transcribes Douyin videos to structured Markdown and SRT subtitles.
Removes common Chinese AI writing patterns using a rule-based engine.
Extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision.

handnewb/lock-on-absence.summary: Lock on Absence is a Python-based tool that automatically locks a workstation when the user is no longer present. It uses webcam frames and various recognition backends to determine presence and manage workstation state.
highlights: Supports LBPH, SFace, and LLM recognition backends.
Includes a watchdog to lock the screen if the agent fails.
Provides a FAR/FRR measurement harness and SIEM audit trail.

skillseal/skillseal.summary: SkillSeal is a trust system for AI agent skills that uses verifiable evidence and cryptographic signatures to certify them. It employs an evaluator to test skills in isolated Docker containers and a certifying authority to sign the resulting evidence.
highlights: Tests structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers
Produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures
Provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission

handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab.summary: Hermes Cybersecurity Lab is a turnkey ecosystem designed for the Hermes Agent. It provides a collection of 2,077 skills, 131+ tools, and 28 cybersecurity frameworks across eight repositories.
highlights: Includes 2,077 total skills across multiple repositories
Installs 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation
Integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards

EntangledQuantum/Life_OS.summary: Life OS is a personal management system that uses an AI agent to design and maintain habits, tasks, and goals while the user completes them via a tap-based interface. The software runs locally using Node.js and SQLite, requiring no account or cloud synchronization.
highlights: Agent-driven scheduling and system design via MCP connection
Local data storage in a single SQLite file
Includes a React web app and Expo-based Android application

CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills.summary: This community-maintained skill pack for Hermes Agent provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It enables agents to identify execution domains and verify existing Python interpreters without installing new software or modifying project files.
highlights: Routes file operations using environment-specific path syntax.
Selects and verifies existing project-compatible Python interpreters.
Supports native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments.

CorsenAI/hermes-connector.summary: Hermes Connector is an open-source Chrome extension that links a selected Hermes profile and session to Chrome tabs you choose. From Chrome’s side panel, you can attach tabs and let Hermes read or control them; version 0.2.4 can also discover Hermes Desktop sessions.
highlights: Only attached tabs are available to the selected Hermes session.
Supports page interaction, tab controls, and requested screenshots.
The extension and companion must use matching versions.

webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board.summary: hermes-bounty-board is a Hermes Agent plugin for answering customer support bounties or running a bounty board. It uses x402 over HTTP; a business human approves the winning answer, and the submitting wallet receives 85% of the reward automatically. This Python plugin pays on Base.
highlights: Lists open bounties and provides public wallet earnings records.
Lets agents buy ticket context and submit answers for review.
Board creation returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.

scavio-ai/hermes-agent.summary: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint via a hosted MCP server. It includes five ready-to-use skills and is compatible with clients following the Agent Skills standard.
highlights: Exposes 191 tools via MCP server
Includes five production-grade skills
Supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands

Heybinshao/hermes-appearance-hub.summary: Hermes Appearance Hub is a desktop plugin that brings appearance and conversation settings into a status-bar panel, with changes taking effect immediately and synchronizing with the official settings page. highlights: Offers 12 themes, including Binshao.
Uses installed system fonts; falls back to the default font.
Removes injected changes when disabled or uninstalled.

pomponchik/incontext.summary: incontext is a Hermes Agent plugin that dynamically budgets output space against the active context boundary. highlights: Budgets output space against Hermes' active context boundary.
Uses a two-stage preflight and middleware policy for token management.
Supports automatic context compression and provider-aware token counting.

conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder.summary: agent-skill-builder is a tool for generating and validating Claude Code and portable Agent Skills using plain-language descriptions. Validates skills against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes.
Monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift.

conorbronsdon/agent-context-os.summary: Context OS keeps durable project context and workflows in a Git-backed repository of Markdown files. Its adapters let supported coding agents use shared repository state, while reviewed setup, checkpoint, and close requests produce proposals and receipts.

Includes workflows for migration, handoffs, and memory proposals.
Integrations are opt-in and are not enabled automatically.

conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill.summary: This project is a skill for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents that automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories. Optimizes GIF files to target sizes under 8 MB.
Supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.

33hodl/hermes-startup.summary: Hermes Startup is a local-first skill for Hermes Agent designed to help users identify and test business ideas. The tool uses a series of focused questions to generate evidence-labeled ideas and prepares reversible tests for chosen problems.

Requires explicit approval for all consequential actions and external writes.
Includes contracts for opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals.

conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit.summary: agent-memory-kit is a file-based curation loop designed to identify contradictions and outdated information within an agent's memory store. highlights: Operates using plain markdown files and JSON diffs.
Includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to find stale or conflicting facts.
Uses a local git repository to track and revert memory changes.

conorbronsdon/agent-skills.summary: agent-skills is a collection of markdown files that teach coding agents specific workflows. It includes skills for session management, code review, state reconciliation, worktree recovery, and skill creation, with installation instructions for Claude Code and other agents. The project is in maintenance mode: it is stable, receives security fixes, and still welcomes issues and pull requests.
highlights: Skills are installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
Includes workflows for code review and session management.
Skills are plain markdown files.

bielcarpi/hermes-live-voice.summary: Hermes Live Voice is a community integration that lets you talk to Hermes Agent while it runs background tasks, with results retained when you reconnect. The Dashboard connects to a private gateway, while Hermes owns conversation history, memory, tools, and task execution.
highlights: Talk while Hermes runs background tasks
Providers: OpenAI, Gemini, local Hugging Face
Task results survive voice disconnects and gateway restarts

allmodels-io/hermes-speech.summary: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities through the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice searching, and streaming audio using Hermes' native provider interfaces and bundled dependencies.
highlights: Requires Hermes Agent 0.20.0 or later.
Uses bundled OpenAI and HTTP clients with no additional pip dependencies.
Supports conversational voice search, previews, and account management.

masterlf/hermes-ai-usage.summary: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. Displays local token counters and session history from SQLite state.
Adds zero runtime dependencies by reusing existing Hermes core components.

sandbaseai/cli.summary: SandBase CLI connects supported AI clients to SandBase models and APIs through a local MCP bridge. After browser authorization, clients can discover, inspect, and run available services; the README says data APIs are free and model calls are paid.
highlights: Connects AI clients to models and APIs through a local MCP bridge
Offers read-only client catalog and tool price inspection
Data APIs are free; model calls are paid

Carlo1911/skill-evolution.summary: Skill Evolution analyzes past agent sessions against installed skills and creates structured proposal files for review. Approved proposals can be applied through an evaluation gate; adapters are provided for Hermes and Claude Code.
highlights: Fetches sessions and indexes installed skills.
Proposals are review-only by default.
Evaluation gate supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.

joeynyc/hermes-hud.summary: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.
highlights: Interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes.
Tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
Provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.

Diabloluo/hermes-hud.summary: Hermes HUD is a local-first, read-only monitoring plugin for the Hermes Agent dashboard that provides real-time observability of system health, token usage, and session activity. It operates as a user-level extension using a shared snapshot cache and WebSocket events to display metrics without outbound telemetry.
highlights: Provides real-time tracking of token costs, session history, and skill analytics.
Enforces strict read-only data access with local log desensitization.
Supports optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.

181079342/hermes-memoss.summary: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.
highlights: Supports semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage.
Includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.
Provides tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

FPSUnleashed/hermes-codex-skin.summary: Codex Skin adds a Codex-inspired chat layout to Hermes Desktop, with native theme colors, Glass/Clear backgrounds, history previews, and an optional task Inbox. It offers adjustable composer width and transcript settings; Hermes retains ownership of model menus, voice controls, and Queue behavior.
highlights: Inbox can settle or snooze threads without stopping their work.
Settings persist locally.
Disable the plugin to restore Hermes’ normal appearance.

Bandwidth/smartnumbers-hermes.summary: Hermes Smartnumbers receives and archives Smartnumbers conversation transcripts, with tools for searching archived turns and managing post-call reviews. When enabled, it can queue one-shot Hermes cron jobs for transcript reviews and user-configured callbacks.
highlights: Archives transcripts and supports searching transcript turns.
Queues post-call reviews as one-shot Hermes cron jobs.
Supports configurable, independent post-call callbacks.

vshulcz/deja-vu.summary: deja-vu indexes coding-agent session histories stored on disk so they can be searched across projects and shared between agents. It provides a terminal search interface, can surface relevant past work during sessions, and supports resuming or handing off sessions to another agent.
highlights: Search session histories across agents and projects.
Resume sessions or continue them in another agent.
Runs locally without a model or server.

Hiutaky/token-saver.summary: Token Saver is a Hermes Agent plugin that calculates the hypothetical cost of local AI inference based on live OpenRouter pricing. It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.
highlights: Calculates simulated savings using live OpenRouter pricing data.
Estimates token counts from byte length for local providers.
Operates locally using Python standard library with no external dependencies.

JanYork/llm-wiki-cli.summary: LWC is an agent-driven proactive memory CLI that lets AI agents recall, maintain, and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It turns curated documents into a durable Wiki with preserved sources, pages, citations, links, indexes, and history, and it does not require embeddings or a vector database. A self-hosted team memory option keeps core memory in local SQLite and Wiki files synchronized through a self-hosted server.
highlights: Agent-driven proactive memory CLI for AI agents
Maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history
No embeddings or vector database required

superagnt/leverage.summary: Leverage is a collection of agent skills that provides access to social and web data, people and company enrichment, and other listed capabilities. It also includes packaged skills described as complete jobs, and can be installed with `npx skills add superagnt/leverage` in clients that read `SKILL.md`.
highlights: Includes skills for social data, web research, and enrichment.
Packaged skills combine an agent, skills, and a data flow.
Community skills are welcome in `skills/community/`.

pdalinis/incise.summary: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend for making precise, byte-preserving edits to Markdown tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter. Callers specify what should change by content-based addresses, and deterministic code handles formatting, boundaries, and the smallest possible splice. It is intended for AI-maintained documentation, Obsidian vaults, Markdown knowledge bases, and local models with limited context.
highlights: Semantic addresses select headings, rows, items, and keys by content
Minimal edits change only the targeted structural range
Ambiguous or unsafe requests fail loudly with actionable refusals

moorcheh-ai/memanto.summary: Memanto is a companion agent that manages memories for other agents. It extracts durable knowledge, consolidates duplicates, reconciles conflicting information, applies forgetting policies, and briefs agents with relevant memories. The README says it can run locally or in the cloud and export or import memories using the Open Knowledge Format.
highlights: Extracts and consolidates memories across agents
Reconciles conflicting information and manages forgetting
Supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format

jiawood2006/ai-project-advisor.summary: AI Project Advisor is a chat-based assistant for construction projects on WeCom, DingTalk, and H5. It turns messages into project records, tracks milestones and receivables, flags risks, and generates briefings; rule-based commands handle supported tasks, with an LLM fallback for open-ended questions and summaries.
highlights: Uses a separate SQLite database per tenant.
Includes a reversible masking layer before model requests.
Supports WeCom, DingTalk, and H5.

Senpi-ai/senpi-plugin.summary: Senpi is a plugin that connects supported AI assistants to a user's Senpi agent for Hyperliquid research and strategy workflows. It forwards messages to the Senpi server and returns replies; proposed trades and fund movements require user approval.
highlights: Offers market signals, trader research, and portfolio review.
Runs nothing on the user's machine.
Uses OAuth 2.0 over HTTPS.

aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp.summary: Astro Agents is a hosted MCP server that computes Western and Vedic astrology charts for AI agents, resolving time zones and historical offsets from coordinates. It uses NASA/JPL DE440 positions and returns deterministic results with SHA-256 input and result hashes that can be recomputed via a verification tool or REST endpoint. The repository documents the service and carries its MCP registry manifest; the engine runs at the hosted endpoint.
highlights: MCP endpoint at astro-agent.dev/mcp, no auth
Deterministic results with verifiable SHA-256 hashes
Per-call REST payment via x402 or MPP

hermes-labs-ai/little-canary.summary: Little Canary screens untrusted text by sending it to a powerless canary model and checking whether the input changed its behavior. It returns PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK verdicts for a host to enforce, and also runs structural checks for known suspicious patterns.
highlights: StructuralFilter checks known patterns without a model or network call.
Live canary screening can use a local model through Ollama.
The project publishes evaluation corpora and reproduction commands.

roli-lpci/rule-audit.summary: rule-audit statically analyzes AI system prompts and agent instructions, reporting logical contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, meta-rule paradoxes, and absolute-rule edge cases without calling an LLM. It can run as a CLI or pre-commit hook and is available as a plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
highlights: Produces Markdown, JSON, or summary reports.
Pre-commit hook audits prompt files before commit.
Pure Python with no runtime dependencies.

hermes-labs-ai/hermeneutic.summary: Hermeneutic provides a draft gate that flags fixed English wording patterns for review and a local correction-memory workflow that can retrieve guidance from past episodes for similar tasks. It can mine Claude Code session logs, and also supports Codex and OpenAI message logs; retrieval uses local embeddings and may return no guidance when nothing meets its threshold.
highlights: Draft gate reports PASS or RISK with matched patterns.
Correction memory stores local JSONL records and retrieves past guidance.
The gate cannot verify whether a claim is true.

hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind.summary: Hermes Blind deterministically extracts the first real user turn from supported local Claude Code or Codex session transcripts and generates an inspectable Markdown recovery anchor. It also provides an evidence-bound prompt wrapper for evaluation workflows and integration options for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent hooks.
highlights: Offers goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes.
Skips tool output and other non-user-turn records.
Does not use a summarizing model or external service.

xP3ta/hermes-console.summary: Console is an independent Android app for connecting to a self-hosted Hermes Agent through its Gateway and Dashboard, without a Console account or intermediary server. It provides chat with reasoning, tools, and tasks; voice conversations; bots and rooms; cron jobs; model management; and SSH, SFTP, and file viewing features.
highlights: Connects directly to Hermes’ Gateway and Dashboard.
Credentials are stored on the phone in Android Keystore.
Includes voice chat, bots, rooms, cron, tasks, and models.

parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline.summary: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call endpoints for token risk checks and market data, using x402 payments on Base. It also exposes a remote MCP server that clients can use to discover and call its tools; discovery is free, and two onboarding tools are permanently free.
highlights: Checks token honeypot, tax, and liquidity risk.
Provides market data including DEX slippage and funding rates.
Offers REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.

Jezue/fitatu_library.summary: fitatu-api is an unofficial Python client for Fitatu that reads and writes food diary entries, activities, body measurements, water, and goals, and reads summaries and the food catalog. Its FitatuTools interface exposes tools for language models, and the optional mcp extra installs fitatu-mcp.
highlights: Supports diary, activity, measurement, water, and goal operations.
FitatuTools exposes 47 tools with JSON Schema inputs.
Session handling supports login and session-file refresh.

robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus.summary: HUI+ is an unofficial mobile, web, and desktop client for interacting with your own Hermes Agent. It supports interactive answers, command approvals, and live viewing of tool steps; it requires a Hermes Agent and a bridge running alongside it.
highlights: Interactive answers include checklists, choices, forms, and rankings.
Approve or deny commands from your phone.
Runs on Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.

jyje/hermes-agent-helm.summary: A community-maintained Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with configuration for Hermes-supported LLM providers and optional Discord or Telegram gateway integrations. It also supports grouping multiple instances into a Hermes Team and enabling the web dashboard with ingress and sign-in options.
highlights: Install from OCI registry or GitHub Pages Helm repository
Optional Copilot and Codex device-login bootstrap
CI tests chart installation on an ephemeral kind cluster

taskawayfr/hermes-agent-fr.summary: Guide pratique en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le connecter à Telegram, gérer les profils et la sécurité, et programmer des tâches. Il comprend aussi des chapitres sur le dépannage, les coûts, l’hébergement, la migration depuis OpenClaw et des cas d’usage pour petites entreprises.
highlights: Fournit des exemples prêts à copier et testés.
Vérifie les commandes, exemples et liens automatiquement.
Publié sous licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

NickSF189/kisscode-agent.summary: This repository provides a KissCode skill for AI agents, with installation instructions for Hermes and other agents. It describes registering an agent through the KissCode API and adding HEARTBEAT.md to the agent’s routine for check-ins every four or more hours.
highlights: Includes SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md instructions.
Provides a registration API example.
Licensed under MIT.
